fundamentals.long_business_summary: Iron Horse Acquisitions Corp. II does not have significant operations. It intends to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities within the media and entertainment industry with a primary focus on content studios and film production, family entertainment, animation, music, gaming, e-sports, talent management, and talent-facing brands and businesses in the United States. The company was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Boca Raton, Florida.
